mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, customer_id, from_owner_id, to_owner_id, from_team_id, to_team_id, status, requested_by, reason, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_reason, base_version, effective_at, created_at, updated_at, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_customer_transfer WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_customer_transfer WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_customer_transfer (tenant_id, customer_id, from_owner_id, to_owner_id, from_team_id, to_team_id, status, requested_by, reason, base_version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{customerId}, #{fromOwnerId}, #{toOwnerId}, #{fromTeamId}, #{toTeamId}, #{status}, #{requestedBy}, #{reason}, #{baseVersion})
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_customer_transfer SET status = #{toStatus}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, review_reason = #{reviewReason}, effective_at = #{effectiveAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.customer_id, t.from_owner_id, fu.display_name AS from_owner_name, t.to_owner_id, tu.display_name AS to_owner_name, t.from_team_id, t.to_team_id, t.status, t.requested_by, ru.display_name AS requested_by_name, t.reason, t.reviewed_by, vu.display_name AS reviewed_by_name, t.reviewed_at, t.review_reason, t.base_version, t.effective_at, t.created_at, t.version FROM crm_customer_transfer t LEFT JOIN sys_user fu ON fu.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND fu.id = t.from_owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND tu.id = t.to_owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND ru.id = t.requested_by LEFT JOIN sys_user vu ON vu.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND vu.id = t.reviewed_by WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY t.id DESC
